name: Silent Ray
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Your voice magically creates a focused beam of sonic energy too shrill to hear. With this ray, you may make a ranged touch attack roll. On a hit, you inflict 1d8 points of sonic damage per caster level (5d8 maximum).
